references.text: David warns Nabal with similar threatening words about the consequences of not listening, where 'bitter men' may attack.
Hushai describes David and his men as 'bitter in spirit' (מָרֵי נֶפֶשׁ), the same expression used here for Dan's men.
Lot warns the men of Sodom that they might make things worse for themselves, a similar warning against provoking dangerous men.
A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger - wisdom about not provoking bitter people.
Men who were 'bitter in spirit' (מַר־נֶפֶשׁ) gathered around David, the same description of desperate and dangerous men.
The people were 'bitter in spirit' and threatened to stone David, showing how bitter men can be dangerous.
